content: Space Grotesk does not ship a Cyrillic subset. Google Fonts serves it only in latin, latin-ext and vietnamese subsets; the typeface (Florian Karsten, 2018) covers Western/Central/South-Eastern European Latin plus Vietnamese and Pinyin, but not Cyrillic. Cross-checked against the project's own mockup, whose 12 Space Grotesk @font-face blocks declare only latin/latin-ext/vietnamese unicode-ranges while IBM Plex Mono declares cyrillic and cyrillic-ext. Consequence for a Russian-language UI: Cyrillic text set in Space Grotesk falls back to the next family in the stack.
